## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The third Taishō recension of [聖堅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%96%E5%A0%85) Shèngjiān's *Śyāmaka-jātaka* translation; signature 「姚秦三藏法師釋聖堅譯」. The dynastic header — 姚秦 ("Yáo-Qín", i.e., the Latter Qín) — represents a catalog mis-attribution of Shèngjiān's translation to the Latter Qín rather than the Western Qín; modern scholarship treats Shèngjiān as a Western-Qín translator, and the 姚秦 attribution as a canonical-tradition variant introduced in later catalogs.

**Abstract**

T175c is the third of three Taishō recensions of [聖堅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%96%E5%A0%85) Shèngjiān's *Śyāmaka-jātaka* translation; see [T175a](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0027) and [T175b](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0028). For broader context on the *Śyāmaka* narrative, see [T174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0026).
